purpose: Teach: 高貴/光源/放電/腹部/劣悪/乳房/置換/有人

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高貴なご家族の医療対応を医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team ensures comprehensive care for your family with the utmost attention.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Direct eye contact. Steady, unhurried delivery. Professional warmth beneath clinical precision. The assurance of someone who has delivered this same care many times.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療現場の光源管理を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes, we maintain rigorous lighting standards throughout our medical facilities.
lines.style: Even-paced, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'rigorous.' No performative warmth—just steady competence. The voice of someone listing facts that matter.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、心臓除細動の放電を医療チームで正確におこないます
lines.en: Ren, our team performs defibrillation procedures with absolute precision.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. Slight pause before the key word. Calm but with underlying seriousness—this is life-or-death work. Voice doesn't waver.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 腹部疾患の鑑別を、貴院、丁寧にされますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does handle differential diagnosis for abdominal conditions very carefully, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, seeking confirmation rather than challenging. Quiet respect underneath. A pause before the final question—genuine curiosity, not flattery. Lean-in energy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、劣悪な居住環境の患者を医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Yes, we provide comprehensive support to patients facing difficult housing circumstances.
lines.style: Steady and matter-of-fact. No pity in the delivery—respect instead. Slight warmth enters the voice here, grounding the clinical language in actual care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、乳房検診を医療チームで推進します
lines.en: Yes, we actively promote breast cancer screening across our patient population.
lines.style: Even tempo, factual. The word 'promote' lands with quiet conviction. Professional and forward-thinking without becoming didactic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 遺伝子置換療法を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital is actively researching gene replacement therapy. That's impressive work, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine admiration underneath careful phrasing. Slightly faster tempo—intellectual interest showing through his usual hesitance. The question is sincere, not performative.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、有人ISSミッションの医療支援も医療チームで関わります
lines.en: Yes, our team also contributes to medical support for manned ISS missions.
lines.style: Pride enters the voice—subtle but present. Slower, more deliberate on the latter half. The scope of the work expands the room. Still measured, but with quiet satisfaction.
